παγιδευω.def: from παγίς (G3803); to ensnare (figuratively). KJV: entangle.

παγισ.def: from πήγνυμι (G4078); a trap (as fastened by a noose or notch); figuratively, a trick or statagem (temptation). KJV: snare.

παθημα.def: from a presumed derivative of πάθος (G3806); something undergone, i.e. hardship or pain; subjectively, an emotion or influence. KJV: affection, affliction, motion, suffering.

παθητοσ.def: from the same as πάθημα (G3804); liable (i.e. doomed) to experience pain. KJV: suffer.

παθοσ.def: from the alternate of πάσχω (G3958); properly, suffering ("pathos"), i.e. (subjectively) a passion (especially concupiscence). KJV: (inordinate) affection, lust.

παιδαγωγοσ.def: from παῖς (G3816) and a reduplicated form of ἄγω (G71); a boy-leader, i.e. a servant whose office it was to take the children to school; (by implication, (figuratively) a tutor ("pædagogue")). KJV: instructor, schoolmaster.

παιδαριον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of παῖς (G3816); a little boy. KJV: child, lad.

παιδεια.def: from παιδεύω (G3811); tutorage, i.e. education or training; by implication, disciplinary correction. KJV: chastening, chastisement, instruction, nurture.

παιδευτησ.def: from παιδεύω (G3811); a trainer, i.e. teacher or (by implication) discipliner. KJV: which corrected, instructor.

παιδευω.def: from παῖς (G3816); to train up a child, i.e. educate, or (by implication), discipline (by punishment). KJV: chasten(-ise), instruct, learn, teach.

παιδιοθεν.def: adverb (of source) from παιδίον (G3813); from infancy. KJV: of a child.

παιδιον.def: neuter diminutive of παῖς (G3816); a childling (of either sex), i.e. (properly), an infant, or (by extension) a half-grown boy or girl; figuratively, an immature Christian. KJV: (little, young) child, damsel.

παιδισκη.def: feminine diminutive of παῖς (G3816); a girl, i.e. (specially), a female slave or servant. KJV: bondmaid(-woman), damsel, maid(-en).

παιζω.def: from παῖς (G3816); to sport (as a boy). KJV: play.

παισ.def: perhaps from παίω (G3817); a boy (as often beaten with impunity), or (by analogy), a girl, and (genitive case) a child; specially, a slave or servant (especially a minister to a king; and by eminence to God). KJV: child, maid(-en), (man) servant, son, young man.

παιω.def: a primary verb; to hit (as if by a single blow and less violently than τύπτω (G5180)); specially, to sting (as a scorpion). KJV: smite, strike.

πακατιανη.def: feminine of an adjective of uncertain derivation; Pacatianian, a section of Phrygia. KJV: Pacatiana.

παλαι.def: probably another form for πάλιν (G3825) (through the idea of retrocession); (adverbially) formerly, or (by relatively) sometime since; (elliptically as adjective) ancient. KJV: any while, a great while ago, (of) old, in time past.

παλαιοσ.def: from πάλαι (G3819); antique, i.e. not recent, worn out. KJV: old.

παλαιοω.def: from παλαιός (G3820); to make (passively, become) worn out, or declare obsolete. KJV: decay, make (wax) old.

παλη.def: from πάλλω (to vibrate; another form for βάλλω (G906)); wrestling. KJV: + wrestle.

παλιγγενεσια.def: from πάλιν (G3825) and γένεσις (G1078); (spiritual) rebirth (the state or the act), i.e. (figuratively) spiritual renovation; specially, Messianic restoration. KJV: regeneration.

παλιν.def: probably from the same as πάλη (G3823) (through the idea of oscillatory repetition); (adverbially) anew, i.e. (of place) back, (of time) once more, or (conjunctionally) furthermore or on the other hand. KJV: again.

παμπληθει.def: dative case (adverb) of a compound of πᾶς (G3956) and πλῆθος (G4128); in full multitude, i.e. concertedly or simultaneously. KJV: all at once.

παμπολυσ.def: from πᾶς (G3956) and πολύς (G4183); full many, i.e. immense. KJV: very great.

παμφυλια.def: from a compound of πᾶς (G3956) and πυρά (G4443); every-tribal, i.e. heterogeneous (χώρα (G5561) being implied); Pamphylia, a region of Asia Minor. KJV: Pamphylia.

πανδοχειον.def: neuter of a presumed compound of πᾶς (G3956) and a derivative of δέχομαι (G1209); all-receptive, i.e. a public lodging-place (caravanserai or khan). KJV: inn.

πανδοχευσ.def: from the same as πανδοχεῖον (G3829); an innkeeper (warden of a caravanserai). KJV: host.

πανηγυρισ.def: from πᾶς (G3956) and a derivative of ἀγορά (G58); a mass-meeting, i.e. (figuratively) universal companionship. KJV: general assembly.

πανοικι.def: adverb from πᾶς (G3956) and οἶκος (G3624); with the whole family. KJV: with all his house.

πανοπλια.def: from a compound of πᾶς (G3956) and ὅπλον (G3696); full armor ("panoply"). KJV: all (whole) armour.

πανουργια.def: from πανοῦργος (G3835); adroitness, i.e. (in a bad sense) trickery or sophistry. KJV: (cunning) craftiness, subtilty.

πανουργοσ.def: from πᾶς (G3956) and ἔργον (G2041); all-working, i.e. adroit (shrewd). KJV: crafty.

πανταχοθεν.def: adverb (of source) from πανταχοῦ (G3837); from all directions. KJV: from every quarter.

πανταχου.def: genitive case (as adverb of place) of a presumed derivative of πᾶς (G3956); universally. KJV: in all places, everywhere.

παντελησ.def: from πᾶς (G3956) and τέλος (G5056); full-ended, i.e. entire (neuter as noun, completion). KJV: + in (no) wise, uttermost.

παντη.def: adverb (of manner) from πᾶς (G3956); wholly. KJV: always.

παντοθεν.def: adverb (of source) from πᾶς (G3956); from (i.e. on) all sides. KJV: on every side, round about.

παντοκρατωρ.def: from πᾶς (G3956) and κράτος (G2904); the all-ruling, i.e. God (as absolute and universal sovereign). KJV: Almighty, Omnipotent.

παντοτε.def: from πᾶς (G3956) and ὅτε (G3753); every when, i.e. at all times. KJV: alway(-s), ever(-more).

παντωσ.def: adverb from πᾶς (G3956); entirely; specially, at all events, (with negative, following) in no event. KJV: by all means, altogether, at all, needs, no doubt, in (no) wise, surely.

παρα.def: a primary preposition; properly, near; i.e. (with genitive case) from beside (literally or figuratively), (with dative case) at (or in) the vicinity of (objectively or subjectively), (with accusative case) to the proximity with (local (especially beyond or opposed to) or causal (on account of). KJV: above, against, among, at, before, by, contrary to, X friend, from, + give (such things as they), + that (she) had, X his, in, more than, nigh unto, (out) of, past, save, side…by, in the sight of, than, (there-)fore, with.

παραβαινω.def: from παρά (G3844) and the base of βάσις (G939); to go contrary to, i.e. violate a command. KJV: (by) transgress(-ion).

παραβαλλω.def: from παρά (G3844) and βάλλω (G906); to throw alongside, i.e. (reflexively) to reach a place, or (figuratively) to liken. KJV: arrive, compare.

παραβασισ.def: from παραβαίνω (G3845); violation. KJV: breaking, transgression.

παραβατησ.def: from παραβαίνω (G3845); a violator. KJV: breaker, transgress(-or).

παραβιαζομαι.def: from παρά (G3844) and the middle voice of βιάζω (G971); to force contrary to (nature), i.e. compel (by entreaty). KJV: constrain.

παραβολη.def: from παραβάλλω (G3846); a similitude ("parable"), i.e. (symbolic) fictitious narrative (of common life conveying a moral), apothegm or adage. KJV: comparison, figure, parable, proverb.

παραβουλευομαι.def: from παρά (G3844) and the middle voice of βουλεύω (G1011); to misconsult, i.e. disregard. KJV: not (to) regard(-ing).

παραγγελια.def: from παραγγέλλω (G3853); a mandate. KJV: charge, command.

παραγγελλω.def: from παρά (G3844) and the base of ἄγγελος (G32); to transmit a message, i.e. (by implication) to enjoin. KJV: (give in) charge, (give) command(-ment), declare.

παραγινομαι.def: from παρά (G3844) and γίνομαι (G1096); to become near, i.e. approach (have arrived); by implication, to appear publicly. KJV: come, go, be present.

παραγω.def: from παρά (G3844) and ἄγω (G71); to lead near, i.e. (reflexively or intransitively) to go along or away. KJV: depart, pass (away, by, forth).

παραδειγματιζω.def: from παρά (G3844) and δειγματίζω (G1165); to show alongside (the public), i.e. expose to infamy. KJV: make a public example, put to an open shame.

παραδεισοσ.def: of Oriental origin (compare H6508); a park, i.e. (specially), an Eden (place of future happiness, "paradise"). KJV: paradise.

παραδεχομαι.def: from παρά (G3844) and δέχομαι (G1209); to accept near, i.e. admit or (by implication) delight in. KJV: receive.

παραδιατριβη.def: from a compound of παρά (G3844) and διατρίβω (G1304); misemployment, i.e. meddlesomeness. KJV: perverse disputing.

παραδιδωμι.def: from παρά (G3844) and δίδωμι (G1325); to surrender, i.e yield up, intrust, transmit. KJV: betray, bring forth, cast, commit, deliver (up), give (over, up), hazard, put in prison, recommend.

παραδοξοσ.def: from παρά (G3844) and δόξα (G1391) (in the sense of seeming); contrary to expectation, i.e. extraordinary ("paradox"). KJV: strange.

παραδοσισ.def: from παραδίδωμι (G3860); transmission, i.e. (concretely) a precept; specially, the Jewish traditionary law. KJV: ordinance, tradition.

παραζηλοω.def: from παρά (G3844) and ζηλόω (G2206); to stimulate alongside, i.e. excite to rivalry. KJV: provoke to emulation (jealousy).

παραθαλασσιοσ.def: from παρά (G3844) and θάλασσα (G2281); along the sea, i.e. maritime (lacustrine). KJV: upon the sea coast.

παραθεωρεω.def: from παρά (G3844) and θεωρέω (G2334); to overlook or disregard. KJV: neglect.

παραθηκη.def: from παρατίθημι (G3908); a deposit, i.e. (figuratively) trust. KJV: committed unto.

παραινεω.def: from παρά (G3844) and αἰνέω (G134); to mispraise, i.e. recommend or advise (a different course). KJV: admonish, exhort.

παραιτεομαι.def: from παρά (G3844) and the middle voice of αἰτέω (G154); to beg off, i.e. deprecate, decline, shun. KJV: avoid, (make) excuse, intreat, refuse, reject.

παρακαθιζω.def: from παρά (G3844) and καθίζω (G2523); to sit down near. KJV: sit.

παρακαλεω.def: from παρά (G3844) and καλέω (G2564); to call near, i.e. invite, invoke (by imploration, hortation or consolation). KJV: beseech, call for, (be of good) comfort, desire, (give) exhort(-ation), intreat, pray.

παρακαλυπτω.def: from παρά (G3844) and καλύπτω (G2572); to cover alongside, i.e. veil (figuratively). KJV: hide.

παρακαταθηκη.def: from a compound of παρά (G3844) and κατατίθημι (G2698); something put down alongside, i.e. a deposit (sacred trust). KJV: that (thing) which is committed (un-)to (trust).

παρακειμαι.def: from παρά (G3844) and κεῖμαι (G2749); to lie near, i.e. be at hand (figuratively, be prompt or easy). KJV: be present.

παρακλησισ.def: from παρακαλέω (G3870); imploration, hortation, solace. KJV: comfort, consolation, exhortation, intreaty.

παρακλητοσ.def: an intercessor, consoler. KJV: advocate, comforter.

παρακοη.def: from παρακούω (G3878); inattention, i.e. (by implication) disobedience. KJV: disobedience.

παρακολουθεω.def: from παρά (G3844) and ἀκολουθέω (G190); to follow near, i.e. (figuratively) attend (as a result), trace out, conform to. KJV: attain, follow, fully know, have understanding.

παρακουω.def: from παρά (G3844) and ἀκούω (G191); to mishear, i.e. (by implication) to disobey. KJV: neglect to hear.

παρακυπτω.def: from παρά (G3844) and κύπτω (G2955); to bend beside, i.e. lean over (so as to peer within). KJV: look (into), stoop down.

παραλαμβανω.def: from παρά (G3844) and λαμβάνω (G2983); to receive near, i.e. associate with oneself (in any familiar or intimate act or relation); by analogy, to assume an office; figuratively, to learn. KJV: receive, take (unto, with).

παραλεγομαι.def: from παρά (G3844) and the middle voice of λέγω (G3004) (in its original sense); (specially), to lay one's course near, i.e. sail past. KJV: pass, sail by.

παραλιοσ.def: from παρά (G3844) and ἅλς (G251); beside the salt (sea), i.e. maritime. KJV: sea coast.

παραλλαγη.def: from a compound of παρά (G3844) and ἀλλάσσω (G236); transmutation (of phase or orbit), i.e. (figuratively) fickleness. KJV: variableness.

παραλογιζομαι.def: from παρά (G3844) and λογίζομαι (G3049); to misreckon, i.e. delude. KJV: beguile, deceive.

παραλυτικοσ.def: from a derivative of παραλύω (G3886); as if dissolved, i.e. "paralytic". KJV: that had (sick of) the palsy.

παραλυω.def: from παρά (G3844) and λύω (G3089); to loosen beside, i.e. relax (perfect passive participle, paralyzed or enfeebled). KJV: feeble, sick of the (taken with) palsy.

παραμενω.def: from παρά (G3844) and μένω (G3306); to stay near, i.e. remain (literally, tarry; or figuratively, be permanent, persevere). KJV: abide, continue.

παραμυθεομαι.def: from παρά (G3844) and the middle voice of a derivative of μῦθος (G3454); to relate near, i.e. (by implication) encourage, console. KJV: comfort.

παραμυθια.def: from παραμυθέομαι (G3888); consolation (properly, abstract). KJV: comfort.

παραμυθιον.def: neuter of παραμυθία (G3889); consolation (properly, concretely). KJV: comfort.

παρανομεω.def: from a compound of παρά (G3844) and νόμος (G3551); to be opposed to law, i.e. to transgress. KJV: contrary to law.

παρανομια.def: from the same as παρανομέω (G3891); transgression. KJV: iniquity.

παραπικραινω.def: from παρά (G3844) and πικραίνω (G4087); to embitter alongside, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate. KJV: provoke.

παραπιπτω.def: from παρά (G3844) and πίπτω (G4098); to fall aside, i.e. (figuratively) to apostatize. KJV: fall away.

παραπλεω.def: from παρά (G3844) and πλέω (G4126); to sail near. KJV: sail by.

παραπλησιον.def: neuter of a compound of παρά (G3844) and the base of πλησίον (G4139) (as adverb); close by, i.e. (figuratively) almost. KJV: nigh unto.

παραπλησιωσ.def: adverb from the same as παραπλήσιον (G3897); in a manner near by, i.e. (figuratively) similarly. KJV: likewise.

παραπορευομαι.def: from παρά (G3844) and πορεύομαι (G4198); to travel near. KJV: go, pass (by).

παραπτωμα.def: from παραπίπτω (G3895); a side-slip (lapse or deviation), i.e. (unintentional) error or (wilful) transgression. KJV: fall, fault, offence, sin, trespass.

παραρρυεω.def: from παρά (G3844) and the alternate of ῥέω (G4482); to flow by, i.e. (figuratively) carelessly pass (miss). KJV: let slip.

παρασημοσ.def: from παρά (G3844) and the base of σημαίνω (G4591); side-marked, i.e. labelled (with a badge (figure-head) of a ship). KJV: sign.

παρασκευαζω.def: from παρά (G3844) and a derivative of σκεῦος (G4632); to furnish aside, i.e. get ready. KJV: prepare self, be (make) ready.

παρασκευη.def: as if from παρασκευάζω (G3903); readiness. KJV: preparation.

παρατεινω.def: from παρά (G3844) and teino (to stretch); to extend along, i.e. prolong (in point of time). KJV: continue.

παρατηρεω.def: from παρά (G3844) and τηρέω (G5083); to inspect alongside, i.e. note insidiously or scrupulously. KJV: observe, watch.

παρατηρησισ.def: from παρατηρέω (G3906); inspection, i.e. ocular evidence. KJV: obervation.

παρατιθημι.def: from παρά (G3844) and τίθημι (G5087); to place alongside, i.e. present (food, truth); by implication, to deposit (as a trust or for protection). KJV: allege, commend, commit (the keeping of), put forth, set before.

παρατυγχανω.def: from παρά (G3844) and τυγχάνω (G5177); to chance near, i.e. fall in with. KJV: meet with.

παραυτικα.def: from παρά (G3844) and a derivative of αὐτός (G846); at the very instant, i.e. momentary. KJV: but for a moment.

παραφερω.def: from παρά (G3844) and φέρω (G5342) (including its alternate forms); to bear along or aside, i.e. carry off (literally or figuratively); by implication, to avert. KJV: remove, take away.

παραφρονεω.def: from παρά (G3844) and φρονέω (G5426); to misthink, i.e. be insane (silly). KJV: as a fool.

παραφρονια.def: from παραφρονέω (G3912); insanity, i.e. foolhardiness. KJV: madness.

παραχειμαζω.def: from παρά (G3844) and χειμάζω (G5492); to winter near, i.e. stay with over the rainy season. KJV: winter.

παραχειμασια.def: from παραχειμάζω (G3914); a wintering over. KJV: winter in.

παραχρημα.def: from παρά (G3844) and χρῆμα (G5536) (in its original sense); at the thing itself, i.e. instantly. KJV: forthwith, immediately, presently, straightway, soon.

παρδαλισ.def: feminine of πάρδος (a panther); a leopard. KJV: leopard.

παρειμι.def: from παρά (G3844) and εἰμί (G1510) (including its various forms); to be near, i.e. at hand; neuter present participle (singular) time being, or (plural) property. KJV: come, X have, be here, + lack, (be here) present.

παρεισαγω.def: from παρά (G3844) and εἰσάγω (G1521); to lead in aside, i.e. introduce surreptitiously. KJV: privily bring in.

παρεισακτοσ.def: from παρεισάγω (G3919); smuggled in. KJV: unawares brought in.

παρεισδυνω.def: from παρά (G3844) and a compound of εἰς (G1519) and δύνω (G1416); to settle in alongside, i.e. lodge stealthily. KJV: creep in unawares.

παρεισερχομαι.def: from παρά (G3844) and εἰσέρχομαι (G1525); to come in alongside, i.e. supervene additionally or steathily. KJV: come in privily, enter.

παρεισφερω.def: from παρά (G3844) and εἰσφέρω (G1533); to bear in alongside, i.e. introduce simultaneously. KJV: give.

παρεκτοσ.def: from παρά (G3844) and ἐκτός (G1622); near outside, i.e. besides. KJV: except, saving, without.

παρεμβολη.def: from a compound of παρά (G3844) and ἐμβάλλω (G1685); a throwing in beside (juxtaposition), i.e. (specially), battle-array, encampment or barracks (tower Antonia). KJV: army, camp, castle.

παρενοχλεω.def: from παρά (G3844) and ἐνοχλέω (G1776); to harass further, i.e. annoy. KJV: trouble.

παρεπιδημοσ.def: from παρά (G3844) and the base of ἐπιδημέω (G1927); an alien alongside, i.e. a resident foreigner. KJV: pilgrim, stranger.

παρερχομαι.def: from παρά (G3844) and ἔρχομαι (G2064); to come near or aside, i.e. to approach (arrive), go by (or away), (figuratively) perish or neglect, (causative) avert. KJV: come (forth), go, pass (away, by, over), past, transgress.

παρεσισ.def: from κτήτωρ (G2935); praetermission, i.e. toleration. KJV: remission.

παρεχω.def: from παρά (G3844) and ἔχω (G2192); to hold near, i.e. present, afford, exhibit, furnish occasion. KJV: bring, do, give, keep, minister, offer, shew, + trouble.

παρηγορια.def: from a compound of παρά (G3844) and a derivative of ἀγορά (G58) (meaning to harangue an assembly); an address alongside, i.e. (specially), consolation. KJV: comfort.

παρθενοσ.def: of unknown origin; a maiden; by implication, an unmarried daughter. KJV: virgin.

παρθοσ.def: probably of foreign origin; a Parthian, i.e. inhabitant of Parthia. KJV: Parthian.

παριημι.def: from παρά (G3844) and hiemi (to send); to let by, i.e. relax. KJV: hang down.

παριστημι.def: from παρά (G3844) and ἵστημι (G2476); to stand beside, i.e. (transitively) to exhibit, proffer, (specially), recommend, (figuratively) substantiate; or (intransitively) to be at hand (or ready), aid. KJV: assist, bring before, command, commend, give presently, present, prove, provide, shew, stand (before, by, here, up, with), yield.

παρμενασ.def: probably by contraction for Παρμενίδης (a derivative of a compound of παρά (G3844) and μένω (G3306)); constant; Parmenas, a Christian. KJV: Parmenas.

παροδοσ.def: from παρά (G3844) and ὁδός (G3598); a by-road, i.e. (actively) a route. KJV: way.

παροικεω.def: from παρά (G3844) and οἰκέω (G3611); to dwell near, i.e. reside as a foreigner. KJV: sojourn in, be a stranger.

παροικια.def: from πάροικος (G3941); foreign residence. KJV: sojourning, X as strangers.

παροικοσ.def: from παρά (G3844) and οἶκος (G3624); having a home near, i.e. (as noun) a by-dweller (alien resident). KJV: foreigner, sojourn, stranger.

παροιμια.def: from a compound of παρά (G3844) and perhaps a derivative of οἴομαι (G3633); apparently a state alongside of supposition, i.e. (concretely) an adage; specially, an enigmatical or fictitious illustration. KJV: parable, proverb.

παροινοσ.def: from παρά (G3844) and οἶνος (G3631); staying near wine, i.e. tippling (a toper). KJV: given to wine.

παροιχομαι.def: from παρά (G3844) and οἴχομαι (to depart); to escape along, i.e. be gone. KJV: past.

παρομοιαζω.def: from παρόμοιος (G3946); to resemble. KJV: be like unto.

παρομοιοσ.def: from παρά (G3844) and ὅμοιος (G3664); alike nearly, i.e. similar. KJV: like.

παροξυνω.def: from παρά (G3844) and a derivative of ὀξύς (G3691); to sharpen alongside, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate. KJV: easily provoke, stir.

παροξυσμοσ.def: from παροξύνω (G3947) ("paroxysm"); incitement (to good), or dispute (in anger). KJV: contention, provoke unto.

παροργιζω.def: from παρά (G3844) and ὀργίζω (G3710); to anger alongside, i.e. enrage. KJV: anger, provoke to wrath.

παροτρυνω.def: from παρά (G3844) and ὀτρύνω (to spur); to urge along, i.e. stimulate (to hostility). KJV: stir up.

παρουσια.def: from the present participle of πάρειμι (G3918); a being near, i.e. advent (often, return; specially, of Christ to punish Jerusalem, or finally the wicked); (by implication) physically, aspect. KJV: coming, presence.

παροψισ.def: from παρά (G3844) and the base of ὀψάριον (G3795); a side-dish (the receptacle). KJV: platter.

παρρησια.def: from πᾶς (G3956) and a derivative of ῥέω (G4483); all out-spokenness, i.e. frankness, bluntness, publicity; by implication, assurance. KJV: bold (X -ly, -ness, -ness of speech), confidence, X freely, X openly, X plainly(-ness).

παρρησιαζομαι.def: middle voice from παῤῥησία (G3954); to be frank in utterance, or confident in spirit and demeanor. KJV: be (wax) bold, (preach, speak) boldly.

πασ.def: including all the forms of declension; apparently a primary word; all, any, every, the whole. KJV: all (manner of, means), alway(-s), any (one), X daily, + ever, every (one, way), as many as, + no(-thing), X thoroughly, whatsoever, whole, whosoever.

πασχα.def: of Chaldee origin (compare H6453); the Passover (the meal, the day, the festival or the special sacrifices connected with it). KJV: Easter, Passover.

πασχω.def: apparently a primary verb; to experience a sensation or impression (usually painful). KJV: feel, passion, suffer, vex.

παταρα.def: probably of foreign origin; Patara, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Patara.

πατασσω.def: probably prolongation from παίω (G3817); to knock (gently or with a weapon or fatally). KJV: smite, strike.

πατεω.def: from a derivative probably of παίω (G3817) (meaning a "path"); to trample (literally or figuratively). KJV: tread (down, under foot).

πατηρ.def: apparently a primary word; a "father" (literally or figuratively, near or more remote). KJV: father, parent.

πατμοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; Patmus, an islet in the Mediterranean. KJV: Patmos.

πατραλωασ.def: from πατήρ (G3962) and the same as the latter part of μητραλῴας (G3389); a parricide. KJV: murderer of fathers.

πατρια.def: as if feminine of a derivative of πατήρ (G3962); paternal descent, i.e. (concretely) a group of families or a whole race (nation). KJV: family, kindred, lineage.

πατριαρχησ.def: from πατριά (G3965) and ἄρχω (G757); a progenitor ("patriarch"). KJV: patriarch.

πατρικοσ.def: from πατήρ (G3962); paternal, i.e. ancestral. KJV: of fathers.

πατρισ.def: from παράσημος (G3902); a father-land, i.e. native town; (figuratively) heavenly home. KJV: (own) country.

πατροβασ.def: perhaps a contraction for Πατρόβιος (a compound of πατήρ (G3962) and βίος (G979)); father's life; Patrobas, a Christian. KJV: Patrobas.

πατροπαραδοτοσ.def: from πατήρ (G3962) and a derivative of παραδίδωμι (G3860) (in the sense of handing over or down); traditionary. KJV: received by tradition from fathers.

πατρωοσ.def: from πατήρ (G3962); paternal, i.e. hereditary. KJV: of fathers.

παυλοσ.def: of Latin origin; (little; but remotely from a derivative of παύω (G3973), meaning the same); Paulus, the name of a Roman and of an apostle. KJV: Paul, Paulus.

παυω.def: a primary verb ("pause"); to stop (transitively or intransitively), i.e. restrain, quit, desist, come to an end. KJV: cease, leave, refrain.

παφοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; Paphus, a place in Cyprus. KJV: Paphos.

παχυνω.def: from a derivative of πήγνυμι (G4078) (meaning thick); to thicken, i.e. (by implication) to fatten (figuratively, stupefy or render callous). KJV: wax gross.

πεδη.def: ultimately from πούς (G4228); a shackle for the feet. KJV: fetter.

πεδινοσ.def: from a derivative of πούς (G4228) (meaning the ground); level (as easy for the feet). KJV: plain.

πεζευω.def: from the same as πεζῇ (G3979); to foot a journey, i.e. travel by land. KJV: go afoot.

πεζη.def: dative case feminine of a derivative of πούς (G4228) (as adverb); foot-wise, i.e. by walking. KJV: a- (on) foot.

πειθαρχεω.def: from a compound of πείθω (G3982) and ἄρχω (G757); to be persuaded by a ruler, i.e. (genitive case) to submit to authority; by analogy, to conform to advice. KJV: hearken, obey (magistrates).

πειθω.def: a primary verb; to convince (by argument, true or false); by analogy, to pacify or conciliate (by other fair means); reflexively or passively, to assent (to evidence or authority), to rely (by inward certainty). KJV: agree, assure, believe, have confidence, be (wax) conflent, make friend, obey, persuade, trust, yield.

πειναω.def: from the same as πένης (G3993) (through the idea of pinching toil; "pine"); to famish (absolutely or comparatively); figuratively, to crave. KJV: be an hungered.

πειρα.def: from the base of πέραν (G4008) (through the idea of piercing); a test, i.e. attempt, experience. KJV: assaying, trial.

πειραζω.def: from πεῖρα (G3984); to test (objectively), i.e. endeavor, scrutinize, entice, discipline. KJV: assay, examine, go about, prove, tempt(-er), try.

πειρασμοσ.def: from πειράζω (G3985); a putting to proof (by experiment (of good), experience (of evil), solicitation, discipline or provocation); by implication, adversity. KJV: temptation, X try.

πειραω.def: from πεῖρα (G3984); to test (subjectively), i.e. (reflexively) to attempt. KJV: assay.

πεισμονη.def: from a presumed derivative of πείθω (G3982); persuadableness, i.e. credulity. KJV: persuasion.

πελαγοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; deep or open sea, i.e. the main. KJV: depth, sea.

πελεκιζω.def: from a derivative of πλήσσω (G4141) (meaning an axe); to chop off (the head), i.e. truncate. KJV: behead.

πεμπω.def: apparently a primary verb; to dispatch (from the subjective view or point of departure, whereas ἵημι (as a stronger form of εἶμι) refers rather to the objective point or terminus ad quem, and στέλλω (G4724) denotes properly, the orderly motion involved), especially on a temporary errand; also to transmit, bestow, or wield. KJV: send, thrust in.

πενησ.def: from a primary πένω (to toil for daily subsistence); starving, i.e. indigent. KJV: poor.

πενθερα.def: feminine of πενθερός (G3995); a wife's mother. KJV: mother in law, wife's mother.

πενθεροσ.def: of uncertain affinity; a wife's father. KJV: father in law.

πενθεω.def: from πένθος (G3997); to grieve (the feeling or the act). KJV: mourn, (be-)wail.

πενθοσ.def: strengthened from the alternate of πάσχω (G3958); grief. KJV: mourning, sorrow.

πενιχροσ.def: prolongation from the base of πένης (G3993); necessitous. KJV: poor.

πεντακισ.def: multiplicative adverb from πέντε (G4002); five times. KJV: five times.

πεντακισχιλιοι.def: from πεντάκις (G3999) and χίλιοι (G5507); five times a thousand. KJV: five thousand.

πεντακοσιοι.def: from πέντε (G4002) and ἑκατόν (G1540); five hundred. KJV: five hundred.

πεντεκαιδεκατοσ.def: from πέντε (G4002) and καί (G2532) and δέκατος (G1182); five and tenth. KJV: fifteenth.

πεντηκοντα.def: multiplicative of πέντε (G4002); fifty. KJV: fifty.

πεντηκοστη.def: feminine of the ordinal of πεντήκοντα (G4004); fiftieth (ἡμέρα (G2250) being implied) from Passover, i.e. the festival of "Pentecost". KJV: Pentecost.

πεποιθησισ.def: from the perfect of the alternate of πάσχω (G3958); reliance. KJV: confidence, trust.

περ.def: from the base of πέραν (G4008); an enclitic particle significant of abundance (thoroughness), i.e. emphasis; much, very or ever. KJV: (whom-)soever.

περαν.def: apparently accusative case of an obsolete derivative of πείρω (to "pierce"); through (as adverb or preposition), i.e. across. KJV: beyond, farther (other) side, over.

περασ.def: from the same as πέραν (G4008); an extremity. KJV: end, ut-(ter-)most participle

περγαμοσ.def: from πύργος (G4444); fortified; Pergamus, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Pergamos.

περγη.def: probably from the same as Πέργαμος (G4010); a tower; Perga, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Perga.

περι.def: from the base of πέραν (G4008); properly, through (all over), i.e. around; figuratively with respect to; used in various applications, of place, cause or time (with the genitive case denoting the subject or occasion or superlative point; with the accusative case the locality, circuit, matter, circumstance or general period). KJV: (there-)about, above, against, at, on behalf of, X and his company, which concern, (as) concerning, for, X how it will go with, ((there-, where-)) of, on, over, pertaining (to), for sake, X (e-)state, (as) touching, (where-)by (in), with.

περιαγω.def: from περί (G4012) and ἄγω (G71); to take around (as a companion); reflexively, to walk around. KJV: compass, go (round) about, lead about.

περιαιρεω.def: from περί (G4012) and αἱρέομαι (G138) (including its alternate); to remove all around, i.e. unveil, cast off (anchor); figuratively, to expiate. KJV: take away (up).

περιαστραπτω.def: from περί (G4012) and ἀστράπτω (G797); to flash all around, i.e. envelop in light. KJV: shine round (about).

περιβαλλω.def: from περί (G4012) and βάλλω (G906); to throw all around, i.e. invest (with a palisade or with clothing). KJV: array, cast about, clothe(-d me), put on.

περιβλεπω.def: from περί (G4012) and βλέπω (G991); to look all around. KJV: look (round) about (on).

περιβολαιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of περιβάλλω (G4016); something thrown around one, i.e. a mantle, veil. KJV: covering, vesture.

περιδεω.def: from περί (G4012) and δέω (G1210); to bind around one, i.e. enwrap. KJV: bind about.

περιεργαζομαι.def: from περί (G4012) and ἐργάζομαι (G2038); to work all around, i.e. bustle about (meddle). KJV: be a busybody.

περιεργοσ.def: from περί (G4012) and ἔργον (G2041); working all around, i.e. officious (meddlesome, neuter plural magic). KJV: busybody, curious arts.

περιερχομαι.def: from περί (G4012) and ἔρχομαι (G2064) (including its alternate); to come all around, i.e. stroll, vacillate, veer. KJV: fetch a compass, vagabond, wandering about.

περιεχω.def: from περί (G4012) and ἔχω (G2192); to hold all around, i.e. include, clasp (figuratively). KJV: + astonished, contain, after (this manner).

περιζωννυμι.def: from περί (G4012) and ζώννυμι (G2224); to gird all around, i.e. (middle voice or passive) to fasten on one's belt (literally or figuratively). KJV: gird (about, self).

περιθεσισ.def: from περιτίθημι (G4060); a putting all around, i.e. decorating oneself with. KJV: wearing.

περιιστημι.def: from περί (G4012) and ἵστημι (G2476); to stand all around, i.e. (near) to be a bystander, or (aloof) to keep away from. KJV: avoid, shun, stand by (round about).

περικαθαρμα.def: from a compound of περί (G4012) and καθαίρω (G2508); something cleaned off all around, i.e. refuse (figuratively). KJV: filth.

περικαλυπτω.def: from περί (G4012) and καλύπτω (G2572); to cover all around, i.e. entirely (the face, a surface). KJV: blindfold, cover, overlay.

περικειμαι.def: from περί (G4012) and κεῖμαι (G2749); to lie all around, i.e. inclose, encircle, hamper (literally or figuratively). KJV: be bound (compassed) with, hang about.

περικεφαλαια.def: feminine of a compound of περί (G4012) and κεφαλή (G2776); encirclement of the head, i.e. a helmet. KJV: helmet.

περικρατησ.def: from περί (G4012) and κράτος (G2904); strong all around, i.e. a master (manager). KJV: + come by.

περικρυπτω.def: from περί (G4012) and κρύπτω (G2928); to conceal all around, i.e. entirely. KJV: hide.

περικυκλοω.def: from περί (G4012) and κυκλόω (G2944); to encircle all around, i.e. blockade completely. KJV: compass round.

περιλαμπω.def: from περί (G4012) and λάμπω (G2989); to illuminate all around, i.e. invest with a halo. KJV: shine round about.

περιλειπω.def: from περί (G4012) and λείπω (G3007); to leave all around, i.e. (passively) survive. KJV: remain.

περιλυποσ.def: from περί (G4012) and λύπη (G3077); grieved all around, i.e. intensely sad. KJV: exceeding (very) sorry(-owful).

περιμενω.def: from περί (G4012) and μένω (G3306); to stay around, i.e. await. KJV: wait for.

περιξ.def: adverb from περί (G4012); all around, i.e. (as an adjective) circumjacent. KJV: round about.

περιοικεω.def: from περί (G4012) and οἰκέω (G3611); to reside around, i.e. be a neighbor. KJV: dwell round about.

περιοικοσ.def: from περί (G4012) and οἶκος (G3624); housed around, i.e. neighboring (used elliptically as a noun). KJV: neighbour.

περιουσιοσ.def: from the present participle feminine of a compound of 4012 and εἰμί (G1510); being beyond usual, i.e. special (one's own). KJV: peculiar.

περιοχη.def: from περιέχω (G4023); a being held around, i.e. (concretely) a passage (of Scripture, as circumscribed). KJV: place.

περιπατεω.def: from περί (G4012) and πατέω (G3961); to tread all around, i.e. walk at large (especially as proof of ability); figuratively, to live, deport oneself, follow (as a companion or votary). KJV: go, be occupied with, walk (about).

περιπειρω.def: from περί (G4012) and the base of πέραν (G4008); to penetrate entirely, i.e. transfix (figuratively). KJV: pierce through.

περιπιπτω.def: from περί (G4012) and πίπτω (G4098); to fall into something that is all around, i.e. light among or upon, be surrounded with. KJV: fall among (into).

περιποιεομαι.def: middle voice from περί (G4012) and ποιέω (G4160); to make around oneself, i.e. acquire (buy). KJV: purchase.

περιποιησισ.def: from περιποιέομαι (G4046); acquisition (the act or the thing); by extension, preservation. KJV: obtain(-ing), peculiar, purchased, possession, saving.

περιρρηγνυμι.def: from περί (G4012) and ῥήγνυμι (G4486); to tear all around, i.e. completely away. KJV: rend off.

περισπαω.def: from περί (G4012) and σπάω (G4685); to drag all around, i.e. (figuratively) to distract (with care). KJV: cumber.

περισσεια.def: from περισσεύω (G4052); surplusage, i.e. superabundance. KJV: abundance(-ant, (-ly)), superfluity.

περισσευμα.def: from περισσεύω (G4052); a surplus, or superabundance. KJV: abundance, that was left, over and above.

περισσευω.def: from περισσός (G4053); to superabound (in quantity or quality), be in excess, be superfluous; also (transitively) to cause to superabound or excel. KJV: (make, more) abound, (have, have more) abundance (be more) abundant, be the better, enough and to spare, exceed, excel, increase, be left, redound, remain (over and above).

περισσοσ.def: from περί (G4012) (in the sense of beyond); superabundant (in quantity) or superior (in quality); by implication, excessive; adverbially (with ἐκ (G1537)) violently; neuter (as noun) preeminence. KJV: exceeding abundantly above, more abundantly, advantage, exceedingly, very highly, beyond measure, more, superfluous, vehement(-ly).

περισσοτερον.def: neuter of περισσότερος (G4055) (as adverb); in a more superabundant way. KJV: more abundantly, a great deal, far more.

περισσοτεροσ.def: comparative of περισσός (G4053); more superabundant (in number, degree or character). KJV: more abundant, greater (much) more, overmuch.

περισσοτερωσ.def: adverb from περισσότερος (G4055); more superabundantly. KJV: more abundant(-ly), X the more earnest, (more) exceedingly, more frequent, much more, the rather.

περισσωσ.def: adverb from περισσός (G4053); superabundantly. KJV: exceedingly, out of measure, the more.

περιστερα.def: of uncertain derivation; a pigeon. KJV: dove, pigeon.

περιτεμνω.def: from περί (G4012) and the base of τομώτερος (G5114); to cut around, i.e. (specially) to circumcise. KJV: circumcise.

περιτιθημι.def: from περί (G4012) and τίθημι (G5087); to place around; by implication, to present. KJV: bestow upon, hedge round about, put about (on, upon), set about.

περιτομη.def: from περιτέμνω (G4059); circumcision (the rite, the condition or the people, literally or figuratively). KJV: X circumcised, circumcision.

περιτρεπω.def: from περί (G4012) and the base of τροπή (G5157); to turn around, i.e. (mentally) to craze. KJV: + make mad.

περιτρεχω.def: from περί (G4012) and τρέχω (G5143) (including its alternate); to run around, i.e. traverse. KJV: run through.

περιφερω.def: from περί (G4012) and φέρω (G5342); to convey around, i.e. transport hither and thither. KJV: bear (carry) about.

περιφρονεω.def: from περί (G4012) and φρονέω (G5426); to think beyond, i.e. depreciate (contemn). KJV: despise.

περιχωροσ.def: from περί (G4012) and χώρα (G5561); around the region, i.e. circumjacent (as noun, with γῆ (G1093) implied vicinity). KJV: country (round) about, region (that lieth) round about.

περιψωμα.def: from a comparative of περί (G4012) and ψάω (to rub); something brushed all around, i.e. off-scrapings (figuratively, scum). KJV: offscouring.

περπερευομαι.def: middle voice from πέρπερος (braggart; perhaps by reduplication of the base of πέραν (G4008)); to boast. KJV: vaunt itself.

περσισ.def: a Persian woman; Persis, a Christian female. KJV: Persis.

περυσι.def: adverb from πέρας (G4009); the by-gone, i.e. (as noun) last year. KJV: + a year ago.

πετεινον.def: neuter of a derivative of πέτομαι (G4072); a flying animal, i.e. bird. KJV: bird, fowl.

πετομαι.def: middle voice of a primary verb; to fly. KJV: fly(-ing).

πετρα.def: feminine of the same as Πέτρος (G4074); a (mass of) rock (literally or figuratively). KJV: rock.

πετροσ.def: apparently a primary word; a (piece of) rock (larger than λίθος (G3037)); as a name, Petrus, an apostle. KJV: Peter, rock.

πετρωδησ.def: from πέτρα (G4073) and εἶδος (G1491); rock-like, i.e. rocky. KJV: stony.

πηγανον.def: from πήγνυμι (G4078); rue (from its thick or fleshy leaves). KJV: rue.

πηγη.def: probably from πήγνυμι (G4078) (through the idea of gushing plumply); a fount (literally or figuratively), i.e. source or supply (of water, blood, enjoyment) (not necessarily the original spring). KJV: fountain, well.

πηγνυμι.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which in its simpler form occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to fix ("peg"), i.e. (specially) to set up (a tent). KJV: pitch.

πηδαλιον.def: neuter of a (presumed) derivative of πηδόν (the blade of an oar; from the same as πέδη (G3976)); a "pedal", i.e. helm. KJV: rudder.

πηλικοσ.def: a quantitative form (the feminine) of the base of πού (G4225); how much (as an indefinite), i.e. in size or (figuratively) dignity. KJV: how great (large).

πηλοσ.def: perhaps a primary word; clay. KJV: clay.

πηρα.def: of uncertain affinity; a wallet or leather pouch for food. KJV: scrip.

πηχυσ.def: of uncertain affinity; the fore-arm, i.e. (as a measure) a cubit. KJV: cubit.

πιαζω.def: probably another form of βιάζω (G971); to squeeze, i.e. seize (gently by the hand (press), or officially (arrest), or in hunting (capture)). KJV: apprehend, catch, lay hand on, take.

πιεζω.def: another form for πιάζω (G4084); to pack. KJV: press down.

πιθανολογια.def: from a compound of a derivative of πείθω (G3982) and λόγος (G3056); persuasive language. KJV: enticing words.

πικραινω.def: from πικρός (G4089); to embitter (literally or figuratively). KJV: be (make) bitter.

πικρια.def: from πικρός (G4089); acridity (especially poison), literally or figuratively. KJV: bitterness.

πικροσ.def: perhaps from πήγνυμι (G4078) (through the idea of piercing); sharp (pungent), i.e. acrid (literally or figuratively). KJV: bitter.

πικρωσ.def: adverb from πικρός (G4089); bitterly, i.e. (figuratively) violently. KJV: bitterly.

πιλατοσ.def: of Latin origin; close-pressed, i.e. firm; Pilatus, a Roman. KJV: Pilate.

πιμπρημι.def: a reduplicated and prolonged form of a primary πρέω; which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to fire, i.e. burn (figuratively and passively, become inflamed with fever). KJV: be (X should have) swollen.

πινακιδιον.def: diminutive of πίναξ (G4094); a tablet (for writing on). KJV: writing table.

πιναξ.def: apparently a form of πλάξ (G4109); a plate. KJV: charger, platter.

πινω.def: a prolonged form of πίω; which (together with another form) πόω; occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses; to imbibe (literally or figuratively). KJV: drink.

πιοτησ.def: from πίων (fat; perhaps akin to the alternate of πίνω (G4095) through the idea of repletion); plumpness, i.e. (by implication) richness (oiliness). KJV: fatness.

πιπρασκω.def: contracted from περάω (to traverse; from the base of πέραν (G4008)); to traffic (by travelling), i.e. dispose of as merchandise or into slavery (literally or figuratively). KJV: sell.

πιπτω.def: probably akin to πέτομαι (G4072) through the idea of alighting; to fall (literally or figuratively). KJV: fail, fall (down), light on.

πισιδια.def: probably of foreign origin; Pisidia, a region of Asia Minor. KJV: Pisidia.

πιστευω.def: from πίστις (G4102); to have faith (in, upon, or with respect to, a person or thing), i.e. credit; by implication, to entrust (especially one's spiritual well-being to Christ). KJV: believe(-r), commit (to trust), put in trust with.

πιστικοσ.def: from πίστις (G4102); trustworthy, i.e. genuine (unadulterated). KJV: spike-(nard).

πιστισ.def: from πείθω (G3982); persuasion, i.e. credence; moral conviction (of religious truth, or the truthfulness of God or a religious teacher), especially reliance upon Christ for salvation; abstractly, constancy in such profession; by extension, the system of religious (Gospel) truth itself. KJV: assurance, belief, believe, faith, fidelity.

πιστοσ.def: from πείθω (G3982); objectively, trustworthy; subjectively, trustful. KJV: believe(-ing, -r), faithful(-ly), sure, true.

πιστοω.def: from πιστός (G4103); to assure. KJV: assure of.

πλαναω.def: from πλάνη (G4106); to (properly, cause to) roam (from safety, truth, or virtue). KJV: go astray, deceive, err, seduce, wander, be out of the way.

πλανη.def: feminine of πλάνος (G4108) (as abstractly); objectively, fraudulence; subjectively, a straying from orthodoxy or piety. KJV: deceit, to deceive, delusion, error.

πλανητησ.def: from πλάνος (G4108); a rover ("planet"), i.e. (figuratively) an erratic teacher. KJV: wandering.

πλανοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; roving (as a tramp), i.e. (by implication) an impostor or misleader;. KJV: deceiver, seducing.

πλαξ.def: from πλάσσω (G4111); a moulding-board, i.e. flat surface ("plate", or tablet, literally or figuratively). KJV: table.

πλασμα.def: from πλάσσω (G4111); something moulded. KJV: thing formed.

πλασσω.def: a primary verb; to mould, i.e. shape or fabricate. KJV: form.

πλαστοσ.def: from πλάσσω (G4111); moulded, i.e. (by implication) artificial or (figuratively) fictitious (false). KJV: feigned.

πλατεια.def: feminine of πλατύς (G4116); a wide "plat" or "place", i.e. open square. KJV: street.

πλατυνω.def: from πλατύς (G4116); to widen (literally or figuratively). KJV: make broad, enlarge.

πλατυσ.def: from πλάσσω (G4111); spread out "flat" ("plot"), i.e. broad. KJV: wide.

πλεγμα.def: from πλέκω (G4120); a plait (of hair). KJV: broidered hair.

πλειστοσ.def: irregular superlative of πολύς (G4183); the largest number or very large. KJV: very great, most.

πλειων.def: comparative of πολύς (G4183); more in quantity, number, or quality; also (in plural) the major portion. KJV: X above, + exceed, more excellent, further, (very) great(-er), long(-er), (very) many, greater (more) part, + yet but.

πλεκω.def: a primary word; to twine or braid. KJV: plait.

πλεοναζω.def: from πλείων (G4119); to do, make or be more, i.e. increase (transitively or intransitively); by extension, to superabound. KJV: abound, abundant, make to increase, have over.

πλεονεκτεω.def: from πλεονέκτης (G4123); to be covetous, i.e. (by implication) to over-reach. KJV: get an advantage, defraud, make a gain.

πλεονεκτησ.def: from πλείων (G4119) and ἔχω (G2192); holding (desiring) more, i.e. eager for gain (avaricious, hence a defrauder). KJV: covetous.

πλεονεξια.def: from πλεονέκτης (G4123); avarice, i.e. (by implication) fraudulency, extortion. KJV: covetous(-ness) practices, greediness.

πλευρα.def: of uncertain affinity; a rib, i.e. (by extension) side. KJV: side.

πλεω.def: probably a form of πλύνω (G4150) (through the idea of plunging through the water); to pass in a vessel. KJV: sail.

πληγη.def: from πλήσσω (G4141); a stroke; by implication, a wound; figuratively, a calamity. KJV: plague, stripe, wound(-ed).

πληθοσ.def: from πλήθω (G4130); a fulness, i.e. a large number, throng, populace. KJV: bundle, company, multitude.

πληθυνω.def: from another form of πλῆθος (G4128); to increase (transitively or intransitively). KJV: abound, multiply.

πληθω.def: a prolonged form of a primary πλέω (which appears only as an alternate in certain tenses and in the reduplicated form pimplemi); to "fill" (literally or figuratively (imbue, influence, supply)); specially, to fulfil (time). KJV: accomplish, full (…come), furnish.

πληκτησ.def: from πλήσσω (G4141); a smiter, i.e. pugnacious (quarrelsome). KJV: striker.

πλημμυρα.def: prolonged from πλήθω (G4130); flood-tide, i.e. (by analogy) a freshet. KJV: flood.

πλην.def: from πλείων (G4119); moreover (besides), i.e. albeit, save that, rather, yet. KJV: but (rather), except, nevertheless, notwithstanding, save, than.

πληρησ.def: from πλήθω (G4130); replete, or covered over; by analogy, complete. KJV: full.

πληροφορεω.def: from πλήρης (G4134) and φορέω (G5409); to carry out fully (in evidence), i.e. completely assure (or convince), entirely accomplish. KJV: most surely believe, fully know (persuade), make full proof of.

πληροφορια.def: from πληροφορέω (G4135); entire confidence. KJV: (full) assurance.

πληροω.def: from πλήρης (G4134); to make replete, i.e. (literally) to cram (a net), level up (a hollow), or (figuratively) to furnish (or imbue, diffuse, influence), satisfy, execute (an office), finish (a period or task), verify (or coincide with a prediction), etc. KJV: accomplish, X after, (be) complete, end, expire, fill (up), fulfil, (be, make) full (come), fully preach, perfect, supply.

πληρωμα.def: from πληρόω (G4137); repletion or completion, i.e. (subjectively) what fills (as contents, supplement, copiousness, multitude), or (objectively) what is filled (as container, performance, period). KJV: which is put in to fill up, piece that filled up, fulfilling, full, fulness.

πλησιον.def: neuter of a derivative of πέλας (near); (adverbially) close by; as noun, a neighbor, i.e. fellow (as man, countryman, Christian or friend). KJV: near, neighbour.

πλησμονη.def: from a presumed derivative of πλήθω (G4130); a filling up, i.e. (figuratively) gratification. KJV: satisfying.

πλησσω.def: apparently another form of πλάσσω (G4111) (through the idea of flattening out); to pound, i.e. (figuratively) to inflict with (calamity). KJV: smite.

πλοιαριον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of πλοῖον (G4143); a boat. KJV: boat, little (small) ship.

πλοιον.def: from πλέω (G4126); a sailer, i.e. vessel. KJV: ship(-ing).

πλοοσ.def: from πλέω (G4126); a sail, i.e. navigation. KJV: course, sailing, voyage.

πλουσιοσ.def: from πλοῦτος (G4149); wealthy; figuratively, abounding with. KJV: rich.

πλουσιωσ.def: adverb from πλούσιος (G4145); copiously. KJV: abundantly, richly.

πλουτεω.def: from πλουτίζω (G4148); to be (or become) wealthy (literally or figuratively). KJV: be increased with goods, (be made, wax) rich.

πλουτιζω.def: from πλοῦτος (G4149); to make wealthy (figuratively). KJV: en- (make) rich.

πλουτοσ.def: from the base of πλήθω (G4130); wealth (as fulness), i.e. (literally) money, possessions, or (figuratively) abundance, richness, (specially), valuable bestowment. KJV: riches.

πλυνω.def: a prolonged form of an obsolete πλύω (to "flow"); to "plunge", i.e. launder clothing. KJV: wash.

πνευμα.def: from πνέω (G4154); a current of air, i.e. breath (blast) or a breeze; by analogy or figuratively, a spirit, i.e. (human) the rational soul, (by implication) vital principle, mental disposition, etc., or (superhuman) an angel, demon, or (divine) God, Christ's spirit, the Holy Spirit. KJV: ghost, life, spirit(-ual, -ually), mind.

πνευματικοσ.def: from πνεῦμα (G4151); non-carnal, i.e. (humanly) ethereal (as opposed to gross), or (dæmoniacally) a spirit (concretely), or (divinely) supernatural, regenerate, religious. KJV: spiritual.

πνευματικωσ.def: adverb from πνευματικός (G4152); non-physically, i.e. divinely, figuratively. KJV: spiritually.

πνεω.def: a primary word; to breathe hard, i.e. breeze. KJV: blow.

πνιγω.def: strengthened from πνέω (G4154); to wheeze, i.e. (causative, by implication) to throttle or strangle (drown). KJV: choke, take by the throat.

πνικτοσ.def: from πνίγω (G4155); throttled, i.e. (neuter concretely) an animal choked to death (not bled). KJV: strangled.

πνοη.def: from πνέω (G4154); respiration, a breeze. KJV: breath, wind.

ποδηρησ.def: from πούς (G4228) and another element of uncertain affinity; a dress (ἐσθής (G2066) implied) reaching the ankles. KJV: garment down to the foot.

ποθεν.def: from the base of πόσις (G4213) with enclitic adverb of origin; from which (as interrogative) or what (as relative) place, state, source or cause. KJV: whence.

ποιεω.def: apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary; to make or do (in a very wide application, more or less direct). KJV: abide, + agree, appoint, X avenge, + band together, be, bear, + bewray, bring (forth), cast out, cause, commit, + content, continue, deal, + without any delay, (would) do(-ing), execute, exercise, fulfil, gain, give, have, hold, X journeying, keep, + lay wait, + lighten the ship, make, X mean, + none of these things move me, observe, ordain, perform, provide, + have purged, purpose, put, + raising up, X secure, shew, X shoot out, spend, take, tarry, + transgress the law, work, yield.

ποιημα.def: from ποιέω (G4160); a product, i.e. fabric (literally or figuratively). KJV: thing that is made, workmanship.

ποιησισ.def: from ποιέω (G4160); action, i.e. performance (of the law). KJV: deed.

ποιητησ.def: from ποιέω (G4160); a performer; specially, a "poet";. KJV: doer, poet.

ποικιλοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; motley, i.e. various in character. KJV: divers, manifold.

ποιμαινω.def: from ποιμήν (G4166); to tend as a shepherd of (figuratively, superviser). KJV: feed (cattle), rule.

ποιμην.def: of uncertain affinity; a shepherd (literally or figuratively). KJV: shepherd, pastor.

ποιμνη.def: contraction from ποιμαίνω (G4165); a flock (literally or figuratively). KJV: flock, fold.

ποιμνιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of ποίμνη (G4167); a flock, i.e. (figuratively) group (of believers). KJV: flock.

ποιοσ.def: from the base of ποῦ (G4226) and οἷος (G3634); individualizing interrogative (of character) what sort of, or (of number) which one. KJV: what (manner of), which.

πολεμεω.def: from πόλεμος (G4171); to be (engaged) in warfare, i.e. to battle (literally or figuratively). KJV: fight, (make) war.

πολεμοσ.def: from πέλομαι (to bustle); warfare (literally or figuratively; a single encounter or a series). KJV: battle, fight, war.

πολισ.def: probably from the same as πόλεμος (G4171), or perhaps from πολύς (G4183); a town (properly, with walls, of greater or less size). KJV: city.

πολιταρχησ.def: from πόλις (G4172) and ἄρχω (G757); a town-officer, i.e. magistrate. KJV: ruler of the city.

πολιτεια.def: from πολίτης (G4177) ("polity"); citizenship; concretely, a community. KJV: commonwealth, freedom.

πολιτευμα.def: from πολιτεύομαι (G4176); a community, i.e. (abstractly) citizenship (figuratively). KJV: conversation.

πολιτευομαι.def: middle voice of a derivative of πολίτης (G4177); to behave as a citizen (figuratively). KJV: let conversation be, live.

πολιτησ.def: from πόλις (G4172); a townsman. KJV: citizen.

πολλακισ.def: multiplicative adverb from πολύς (G4183); many times, i.e. frequently. KJV: oft(-en, -entimes, -times).

πολλαπλασιων.def: from πολύς (G4183) and probably a derivative of πλέκω (G4120); manifold, i.e. (neuter as noun) very much more. KJV: manifold more.

πολυλογια.def: from a compound of πολύς (G4183) and λόγος (G3056); loquacity, i.e. prolixity. KJV: much speaking.

πολυμερωσ.def: adverb from a compound of πολύς (G4183) and μέρος (G3313); in many portions, i.e. variously as to time and agency (piecemeal). KJV: at sundry times.

πολυποικιλοσ.def: from πολύς (G4183) and ποικίλος (G4164); much variegated, i.e. multifarious. KJV: manifold.

πολυσ.def: including the forms from the alternate πολλός; (singular) much (in any respect) or (plural) many; neuter (singular) as adverbial, largely; neuter (plural) as adverb or noun often, mostly, largely. KJV: abundant, + altogether, common, + far (passed, spent), (+ be of a) great (age, deal, -ly, while), long, many, much, oft(-en (-times)), plenteous, sore, straitly.

πολυσπλαγχνοσ.def: from πολύς (G4183) and σπλάγχνον (G4698) (figuratively); extremely compassionate. KJV: very pitiful.

πολυτελησ.def: from πολύς (G4183) and τέλος (G5056); extremely expensive. KJV: costly, very precious, of great price.

πολυτιμοσ.def: from πολύς (G4183) and τιμή (G5092); extremely valuable. KJV: very costly, of great price.

πολυτροπωσ.def: adverb from a compound of πολύς (G4183) and τρόπος (G5158); in many ways, i.e. variously as to method or form. KJV: in divers manners.

πομα.def: from the alternate of πίνω (G4095); a beverage. KJV: drink.

πονηρια.def: from πονηρός (G4190); depravity, i.e. (specially), malice; plural (concretely) plots, sins. KJV: iniquity, wickedness.

πονηροσ.def: from a derivative of πόνος (G4192); hurtful, i.e. evil (properly, in effect or influence, and thus differing from κακός (G2556), which refers rather to essential character, as well as from σαπρός (G4550), which indicates degeneracy from original virtue); figuratively, calamitous; also (passively) ill, i.e. diseased; but especially (morally) culpable, i.e. derelict, vicious, facinorous; neuter (singular) mischief, malice, or (plural) guilt; masculine (singular) the devil, or (plural) sinners. KJV: bad, evil, grievous, harm, lewd, malicious, wicked(-ness).

πονηροτεροσ.def: comparative of πονηρός (G4190); more evil. KJV: more wicked.

πονοσ.def: from the base of πένης (G3993); toil, i.e. (by implication) anguish. KJV: pain.

ποντικοσ.def: from Πόντος (G4195); a Pontican, i.e. native of Pontus. KJV: born in Pontus.

ποντιοσ.def: of Latin origin; apparently bridged; Pontius, a Roman. KJV: Pontius.

ποντοσ.def: of Latin origin; a sea; Pontus, a region of Asia Minor. KJV: Pontus.

ποπλιοσ.def: of Latin origin; apparently "popular"; Poplius (i.e. Publius), a Roman. KJV: Publius.

πορεια.def: from πορεύομαι (G4198); travel (by land); figuratively (plural) proceedings, i.e. career. KJV: journey(-ing), ways.

πορευομαι.def: middle voice from a derivative of the same as πεῖρα (G3984); to traverse, i.e. travel (literally or figuratively; especially to remove (figuratively, die), live, etc.);. KJV: depart, go (away, forth, one's way, up), (make a, take a) journey, walk.

πορθεω.def: prolongation from πέρθω (to sack); to ravage (figuratively). KJV: destroy, waste.

πορισμοσ.def: from a derivative of πόρος (a way, i.e. means); furnishing (procuring), i.e. (by implication) money-getting (acquisition). KJV: gain.

πορκιοσ.def: of Latin origin; apparently swinish; Porcius, a Roman. KJV: Porcius.

πορνεια.def: from πορνεύω (G4203); harlotry (including adultery and incest); figuratively, idolatry. KJV: fornication.

πορνευω.def: from πόρνη (G4204); to act the harlot, i.e. (literally) indulge unlawful lust (of either sex), or (figuratively) practise idolatry. KJV: commit (fornication).

πορνη.def: feminine of πόρνος (G4205); a strumpet; figuratively, an idolater. KJV: harlot, whore.

πορνοσ.def: from πέρνημι (to sell; akin to the base of πιπράσκω (G4097)); a (male) prostitute (as venal), i.e. (by analogy) a debauchee (libertine). KJV: fornicator, whoremonger.

πορρω.def: adverb from πρό (G4253); forwards, i.e. at a distance. KJV: far, a great way off.

πορρωθεν.def: from πόῤῥω (G4206) with adverbial enclitic of source; from far, or (by implication) at a distance, i.e. distantly. KJV: afar off.

πορρωτερω.def: adverb comparative of πόῤῥω (G4206); further, i.e. a greater distance. KJV: farther.

πορφυρα.def: of Latin origin; the "purple" mussel, i.e. (by implication) the red-blue color itself, and finally a garment dyed with it. KJV: purple.

πορφυροπωλισ.def: feminine of a compound of πορφύρα (G4209) and πωλέω (G4453); a female trader in purple cloth. KJV: seller of purple.

πορφυρουσ.def: from πορφύρα (G4209); purpureal, i.e. bluish red. KJV: purple.

ποσακισ.def: multiplicative from πόσος (G4214); how many times. KJV: how oft(-en).

ποσισ.def: from the alternate of πίνω (G4095); a drinking (the act), i.e. (concretely) a draught. KJV: drink.

ποσοσ.def: from an absolute πός (who, what) and ὅς (G3739); interrogative pronoun (of amount) how much (large, long or (plural) many). KJV: how great (long, many), what.

ποταμοσ.def: probably from a derivative of the alternate of πίνω (G4095) (compare πότος (G4224)); a current, brook or freshet (as drinkable), i.e. running water. KJV: flood, river, stream, water.

ποταμοφορητοσ.def: from ποταμός (G4215) and a derivative of φορέω (G5409); river-borne, i.e. overwhelmed by a stream. KJV: carried away of the flood.

ποταποσ.def: apparently from πότε (G4219) and the base of ποῦ (G4226); interrogatively, whatever, i.e. of what possible sort. KJV: what (manner of).

ποτε.def: from the base of πού (G4225) and τέ (G5037); indefinite adverb, at some time, ever. KJV: afore-(any, some-)time(-s), at length (the last), (+ n-)ever, in the old time, in time past, once, when.
from the base of ποῦ (G4226) and τέ (G5037); interrogative adverb, at what time. KJV: + how long, when.

ποτερον.def: neuter of a comparative of the base of ποῦ (G4226); interrogative as adverb, which (of two), i.e. is it this or that. KJV: whether.

ποτηριον.def: neuter of a derivative of the alternate of πίνω (G4095); a drinking-vessel; by extension, the contents thereof, i.e. a cupful (draught); figuratively, a lot or fate. KJV: cup.

ποτιζω.def: from a derivative of the alternate of πίνω (G4095); to furnish drink, irrigate. KJV: give (make) to drink, feed, water.

ποτιολοι.def: of Latin origin; little wells, i.e. mineral springs; Potioli (i.e. Puteoli), a place in Italy. KJV: Puteoli.

ποτοσ.def: from the alternate of πίνω (G4095); a drinking-bout or carousal. KJV: banqueting.

που.def: genitive case of an indefinite pronoun πός (some) otherwise obsolete (compare πόσος (G4214)); as adverb of place, somewhere, i.e. nearly. KJV: about, a certain place.

genitive case of an interrogative pronoun πός (what) otherwise obsolete (perhaps the same as πού (G4225) used with the rising slide of inquiry); as adverb of place; at (by implication, to) what locality. KJV: where, whither.

πουδησ.def: of Latin origin; modest; Pudes (i.e. Pudens), a Christian. KJV: Pudens.

πουσ.def: a primary word; a "foot" (figuratively or literally). KJV: foot(-stool).

πραγμα.def: from πράσσω (G4238); a deed; by implication, an affair; by extension, an object (material). KJV: business, matter, thing, work.

πραγματεια.def: from πραγματεύομαι (G4231); a transaction, i.e. negotiation. KJV: affair.

πραγματευομαι.def: from πρᾶγμα (G4229); to busy oneself with, i.e. to trade. KJV: occupy.

πραιτωριον.def: of Latin origin; the prætorium or governor's courtroom (sometimes including the whole edifice and camp). KJV: (common, judgment) hall (of judgment), palace, prætorium.

πρακτωρ.def: from a derivative of πράσσω (G4238); a practiser, i.e. (specially), an official collector. KJV: officer.

πραξισ.def: from πράσσω (G4238); practice, i.e. (concretely) an act; by extension, a function. KJV: deed, office, work.

πραοσ.def: a form of πραΰς (G4239), used in certain parts; gentle, i.e. humble. KJV: meek.

πραοτησ.def: from πρᾷος (G4235); gentleness, by implication, humility. KJV: meekness.

πρασια.def: perhaps from πράσον (a leek, and so an onion-patch); a garden plot, i.e. (by implication, of regular beds) a row (repeated in plural by Hebraism, to indicate an arrangement). KJV: in ranks.

πρασσω.def: a primary verb; to "practise", i.e. perform repeatedly or habitually (thus differing from ποιέω (G4160), which properly refers to a single act); by implication, to execute, accomplish, etc.; specially, to collect (dues), fare (personally). KJV: commit, deeds, do, exact, keep, require, use arts.

πραυσ.def: apparently a primary word; mild, i.e. (by implication) humble. KJV: meek.

πραυτησ.def: from πραΰς (G4239); mildness, i.e. (by implication) humility. KJV: meekness.

πρεπω.def: apparently a primary verb; to tower up (be conspicuous), i.e. (by implication) to be suitable or proper (third person singular present indicative, often used impersonally, it is fit or right). KJV: become, comely.

πρεσβεια.def: from πρεσβεύω (G4243); seniority (eldership), i.e. (by implication) an embassy (concretely, ambassadors). KJV: ambassage, message.

πρεσβευω.def: from the base of πρεσβύτερος (G4245); to be a senior, i.e. (by implication) act as a representative (figuratively, preacher). KJV: be an ambassador.

πρεσβυτεριον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of πρεσβύτερος (G4245); the order of elders, i.e. (specially), Israelite Sanhedrin or Christian "presbytery". KJV: (estate of) elder(-s), presbytery.

πρεσβυτεροσ.def: comparative of πρέσβυς (elderly); older; as noun, a senior; specially, an Israelite Sanhedrist (also figuratively, member of the celestial council) or Christian "presbyter". KJV: elder(-est), old.

πρεσβυτησ.def: from the same as πρεσβύτερος (G4245); an old man. KJV: aged (man), old man.

πρεσβυτισ.def: feminine of πρεσβύτης (G4246); an old woman. KJV: aged woman.

πρηνησ.def: from πρό (G4253); leaning (falling) forward ("prone"), i.e. head foremost. KJV: headlong.

πριζω.def: a strengthened form of a primary prio (to saw); to saw in two. KJV: saw asunder.

πριν.def: adverb from πρό (G4253); prior, sooner. KJV: before (that), ere.

πρισκα.def: of Latin origin; feminine of Priscus, ancient; Priska, a Christian woman. KJV: Prisca.

πρισκιλλα.def: diminutive of Πρίσκα (G4251); Priscilla (i.e. little Prisca), a Christian woman. KJV: Priscilla.

προ.def: a primary preposition; "fore", i.e. in front of, prior (figuratively, superior) to. KJV: above, ago, before, or ever.

προαγω.def: from πρό (G4253) and ἄγω (G71); to lead forward (magisterially); intransitively, to precede (in place or time (participle, previous)). KJV: bring (forth, out), go before.

προαιρεομαι.def: from πρό (G4253) and αἱρέομαι (G138); to choose for oneself before another thing (prefer), i.e. (by implication) to propose (intend). KJV: purpose.

προαιτιαομαι.def: from πρό (G4253) and a derivative of αἰτία (G156); to accuse already, i.e. previously charge. KJV: prove before.

προακουω.def: from πρό (G4253) and ἀκούω (G191); to hear already,i.e. anticipate. KJV: hear before.

προαμαρτανω.def: from πρό (G4253) and ἁμαρτάνω (G264); to sin previously (to conversion). KJV: sin already, heretofore sin.

προαυλιον.def: neuter of a presumed compound of πρό (G4253) and αὐλή (G833); a forecourt, i.e. vestibule (alley-way). KJV: porch.

προβαινω.def: from πρό (G4253) and the base of βάσις (G939); to walk forward, i.e. advance (literally, or in years). KJV: + be of a great age, go farther (on), be well stricken.

προβαλλω.def: from πρό (G4253) and βάλλω (G906); to throw forward, i.e. push to the front, germinate. KJV: put forward, shoot forth.

προβατικοσ.def: from πρόβατον (G4263); relating to sheep, i.e. (a gate) through which they were led into Jerusalem. KJV: sheep (market).

προβατον.def: probably neuter of a presumed derivative of προβαίνω (G4260); something that walks forward (a quadruped), i.e. (specially), a sheep (literally or figuratively). KJV: sheep(-fold).

προβιβαζω.def: from πρό (G4253) and a reduplicated form of βιάζω (G971); to force forward, i.e. bring to the front, instigate. KJV: draw, before instruct.

προβλεπω.def: from πρό (G4253) and βλέπω (G991); to look out beforehand, i.e. furnish in advance. KJV: provide.

προγινομαι.def: from πρό (G4253) and γίνομαι (G1096); to be already, i.e. have previousy transpired. KJV: be past.

προγινωσκω.def: from πρό (G4253) and γινώσκω (G1097); to know beforehand, i.e. foresee. KJV: foreknow (ordain), know (before).

προγονοσ.def: from προγίνομαι (G4266); an ancestor, (grand-)parent. KJV: forefather, parent.

προγραφω.def: from πρό (G4253) and γράφω (G1125); to write previously; figuratively, to announce, prescribe. KJV: before ordain, evidently set forth, write (afore, aforetime).

προδηλοσ.def: from πρό (G4253) and δῆλος (G1212); plain before all men, i.e. obvious. KJV: evident, manifest (open) beforehand.

προδιδωμι.def: from πρό (G4253) and δίδωμι (G1325); to give before the other party has given. KJV: first give.

προδοτησ.def: from προδίδωμι (G4272) (in the sense of giving forward into another's (the enemy's) hands); a surrender. KJV: betrayer, traitor.

προδρομοσ.def: from the alternate of προτρέχω (G4390); a runner ahead, i.e. scout (figuratively, precursor). KJV: forerunner.

προειδω.def: from πρό (G4253) and εἴδω (G1492); foresee. KJV: foresee, saw before.

προελπιζω.def: from πρό (G4253) and ἐλπίζω (G1679); to hope in advance of other confirmation. KJV: first trust.

προεναρχομαι.def: from πρό (G4253) and ἐνάρχομαι (G1728); to commence already. KJV: begin (before).

προεπαγγελλομαι.def: middle voice from πρό (G4253) and ἐπαγγέλλω (G1861); to promise of old. KJV: promise before.

προεπω.def: from πρό (G4253) and ἔπω (G2036); to say already, to predict. KJV: forewarn, say (speak, tell) before.

προερεω.def: from πρό (G4253) and ἐρέω (G2046); used as alternate of προέπω (G4277); to say already, predict. KJV: foretell, say (speak, tell) before.

προερχομαι.def: from πρό (G4253) and ἔρχομαι (G2064) (including its alternate); to go onward, precede (in place or time). KJV: go before (farther, forward), outgo, pass on.

προετοιμαζω.def: from πρό (G4253) and ἑτοιμάζω (G2090); to fit up in advance (literally or figuratively). KJV: ordain before, prepare afore.

προευαγγελιζομαι.def: middle voice from πρό (G4253) and εὐαγγελίζω (G2097); to announce glad news in advance. KJV: preach before the gospel.

προεχομαι.def: middle voice from πρό (G4253) and ἔχω (G2192); to hold oneself before others, i.e. (figuratively) to excel. KJV: be better.

προηγεομαι.def: from πρό (G4253) and ἡγέομαι (G2233); to lead the way for others, i.e. show deference. KJV: prefer.

προθεσισ.def: from προτίθεμαι (G4388); a setting forth, i.e. (figuratively) proposal (intention); specially, the show-bread (in the Temple) as exposed before God. KJV: purpose, shew(-bread).

προθεσμιοσ.def: from πρό (G4253) and a derivative of τίθημι (G5087); fixed beforehand, i.e. (feminine with ἡμέρα (G2250) implied) a designated day. KJV: time appointed.

προθυμια.def: from πρόθυμος (G4289); predisposition, i.e. alacrity. KJV: forwardness of mind, readiness (of mind), ready (willing) mind.

προθυμοσ.def: from πρό (G4253) and θυμός (G2372); forward in spirit, i.e. predisposed; neuter (as noun) alacrity. KJV: ready, willing.

προθυμωσ.def: adverb from πρόθυμος (G4289); with alacrity. KJV: willingly.

προιστημι.def: from πρό (G4253) and ἵστημι (G2476); to stand before, i.e. (in rank) to preside, or (by implication) to practise. KJV: maintain, be over, rule.

προκαλεομαι.def: middle voice from πρό (G4253) and καλέω (G2564); to call forth to oneself (challenge), i.e. (by implication) to irritate. KJV: provoke.

προκαταγγελλω.def: from πρό (G4253) and καταγγέλλω (G2605); to anounce beforehand, i.e. predict, promise. KJV: foretell, have notice, (shew) before.

προκαταρτιζω.def: from πρό (G4253) and καταρτίζω (G2675); to prepare in advance. KJV: make up beforehand.

προκειμαι.def: from πρό (G4253) and κεῖμαι (G2749); to lie before the view, i.e. (figuratively) to be present (to the mind), to stand forth (as an example or reward). KJV: be first, set before (forth).

προκηρυσσω.def: from πρό (G4253) and κηρύσσω (G2784); to herald (i.e. proclaim) in advance. KJV: before (first) preach.

προκοπη.def: from προκόπτω (G4298); progress, i.e. advancement (subjectively or objectively). KJV: furtherance, profit.

προκοπτω.def: from πρό (G4253) and κόπτω (G2875); to drive forward (as if by beating), i.e. (figuratively and intransitively) to advance (in amount, to grow; in time, to be well along). KJV: increase, proceed, profit, be far spent, wax.

προκριμα.def: from a compound of πρό (G4253) and κρίνω (G2919); a prejudgment (prejudice), i.e. prepossession. KJV: prefer one before another.

προκυροω.def: from πρό (G4253) and κυρόω (G2964); to ratify previously. KJV: confirm before.

προλαμβανω.def: from πρό (G4253) and λαμβάνω (G2983); to take in advance, i.e. (literally) eat before others have an opportunity; (figuratively) to anticipate, surprise. KJV: come aforehand, overtake, take before.

προλεγω.def: from πρό (G4253) and λέγω (G3004); to say beforehand, i.e. predict, forewarn. KJV: foretell, tell before.

προμαρτυρομαι.def: from πρό (G4253) and μαρτύρομαι (G3143); to be a witness in advance i.e. predict. KJV: testify beforehand.

προμελεταω.def: from πρό (G4253) and μελετάω (G3191); to premeditate. KJV: meditate before.

προμεριμναω.def: from πρό (G4253) and μεριμνάω (G3309); to care (anxiously) in advance. KJV: take thought beforehand.

προνοεω.def: from πρό (G4253) and νοιέω (G3539); to consider in advance, i.e. look out for beforehand (actively, by way of maintenance for others; middle voice by way of circumspection for oneself). KJV: provide (for).

προνοια.def: from προνοέω (G4306); forethought, i.e. provident care or supply. KJV: providence, provision.

προοραω.def: from πρό (G4253) and ὁράω (G3708); to behold in advance, i.e. (actively) to notice (another) previously, or (middle voice) to keep in (one's own) view. KJV: foresee, see before.

προοριζω.def: from πρό (G4253) and ὁρίζω (G3724); to limit in advance, i.e. (figuratively) predetermine. KJV: determine before, ordain, predestinate.

προπασχω.def: from πρό (G4253) and πάσχω (G3958); to undergo hardship previously. KJV: suffer before.

προπεμπω.def: from πρό (G4253) and πέμπω (G3992); to send forward, i.e. escort or aid in travel. KJV: accompany, bring (forward) on journey (way), conduct forth.

προπετησ.def: from a compound of πρό (G4253) and πίπτω (G4098); falling forward, i.e. headlong (figuratively, precipitate). KJV: heady, rash(-ly).

προπορευομαι.def: from πρό (G4253) and πορεύομαι (G4198); to precede (as guide or herald). KJV: go before.

προσ.def: a strengthened form of πρό (G4253); a preposition of direction; forward to, i.e. toward (with the genitive case, the side of, i.e. pertaining to; with the dative case, by the side of, i.e. near to; usually with the accusative case, the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the destination of the relation, i.e. whither or for which it is predicated). KJV: about, according to, against, among, at, because of, before, between, (where-)by, for, X at thy house, in, for intent, nigh unto, of, which pertain to, that, to (the end that), X together, to (you) -ward, unto, with(-in).

προσαββατον.def: from πρό (G4253) and σάββατον (G4521); a fore-sabbath, i.e. the Sabbath-eve. KJV: day before the sabbath.

προσαγορευω.def: from πρός (G4314) and a derivative of ἀγορά (G58) (mean to harangue); to address, i.e. salute by name. KJV: call.

προσαγω.def: from πρός (G4314) and ἄγω (G71); to lead towards, i.e. (transitively) to conduct near (summon, present), or (intransitively) to approach. KJV: bring, draw near.

προσαγωγη.def: from προσάγω (G4317) (compare ἀγωγή (G72)); admission. KJV: access.

προσαιτεω.def: from πρός (G4314) and αἰτέω (G154); to ask repeatedly (importune), i.e. solicit. KJV: beg.

προσαναβαινω.def: from πρός (G4314) and ἀναβαίνω (G305); to ascend farther, i.e. be promoted (take an upper (more honorable) seat). KJV: go up.

προσαναλισκω.def: from πρός (G4314) and ἀναλίσκω (G355); to expend further. KJV: spend.

προσαναπληροω.def: from πρός (G4314) and ἀναπληρόω (G378); to fill up further, i.e. furnish fully. KJV: supply.

προσανατιθημι.def: from πρός (G4314) and ἀνατίθεμαι (G394); to lay up in addition, i.e. (middle voice and figuratively) to impart or (by implication) to consult. KJV: in conference add, confer.

προσαπειλεω.def: from πρός (G4314) and ἀπειλέω (G546); to menace additionally. KJV: i.

προσδαπαναω.def: from πρός (G4314) and δαπανάω (G1159); to expend additionally. KJV: spend more.

προσδεομαι.def: from πρός (G4314) and δέομαι (G1189); to require additionally, i.e. want further. KJV: need.

προσδεχομαι.def: from πρός (G4314) and δέχομαι (G1209); to admit (to intercourse, hospitality, credence, or (figuratively) endurance); by implication, to await (with confidence or patience). KJV: accept, allow, look (wait) for, take.

προσδοκαω.def: from πρός (G4314) and dokeuo (to watch); to anticipate (in thought, hope or fear); by implication, to await. KJV: (be in) expect(-ation), look (for), when looked, tarry, wait for.

προσδοκια.def: from προσδοκάω (G4328); apprehension (of evil); by implication, infliction anticipated. KJV: expectation, looking after.

προσεαω.def: from πρός (G4314) and ἐάω (G1439); to permit further progress. KJV: suffer.

προσεγγιζω.def: from πρός (G4314) and ἐγγίζω (G1448); to approach near. KJV: come nigh.

προσεδρευω.def: from a compound of πρός (G4314) and the base of ἑδραῖος (G1476); to sit near, i.e. attend as a servant. KJV: wait at.

προσεργαζομαι.def: from πρός (G4314) and ἐργάζομαι (G2038); to work additionally, i.e. (by implication) acquire besides. KJV: gain.

προσερχομαι.def: from πρός (G4314) and ἔρχομαι (G2064) (including its alternate); to approach, i.e. (literally) come near, visit, or (figuratively) worship, assent to. KJV: (as soon as he) come (unto), come thereunto, consent, draw near, go (near, to, unto).

προσευχη.def: from προσεύχομαι (G4336); prayer (worship); by implication, an oratory (chapel). KJV: X pray earnestly, prayer.

προσευχομαι.def: from πρός (G4314) and εὔχομαι (G2172); to pray to God, i.e. supplicate, worship. KJV: pray (X earnestly, for), make prayer.

προσεχω.def: from πρός (G4314) and ἔχω (G2192); (figuratively) to hold the mind (3563 implied) towards, i.e. pay attention to, be cautious about, apply oneself to, adhere to. KJV: (give) attend(-ance, -ance at, -ance to, unto), beware, be given to, give (take) heed (to unto); have regard.

προσηλοω.def: from πρός (G4314) and a derivative of ἧλος (G2247); to peg to, i.e. spike fast. KJV: nail to.

προσηλυτοσ.def: from the alternate of προσέρχομαι (G4334); an arriver from a foreign region, i.e. (specially), an acceder (convert) to Judaism ("proselyte"). KJV: proselyte.

προσκαιροσ.def: from πρός (G4314) and καιρός (G2540); for the occasion only, i.e. temporary. KJV: dur-(eth) for awhile, endure for a time, for a season, temporal.

προσκαλεομαι.def: middle voice from πρός (G4314) and καλέω (G2564); to call toward oneself, i.e. summon, invite. KJV: call (for, to, unto).

προσκαρτερεω.def: from πρός (G4314) and καρτερέω (G2594); to be earnest towards, i.e. (to a thing) to persevere, be constantly diligent, or (in a place) to attend assiduously all the exercises, or (to a person) to adhere closely to (as a servitor). KJV: attend (give self) continually (upon), continue (in, instant in, with), wait on (continually).

προσκεφαλαιον.def: neuter of a presumed compound of πρός (G4314) and κεφαλή (G2776); something for the head, i.e. a cushion. KJV: pillow.

προσκληροω.def: from πρός (G4314) and κληρόω (G2820); to give a common lot to, i.e. (figuratively) to associate with. KJV: consort with.

προσκλισισ.def: from a compound of πρός (G4314) and κλίνω (G2827); a leaning towards, i.e. (figuratively) proclivity (favoritism). KJV: partiality.

προσκολλαω.def: from πρός (G4314) and κολλάω (G2853); to glue to, i.e. (figuratively) to adhere. KJV: cleave, join (self).

προσκομμα.def: from προσκόπτω (G4350); a stub, i.e. (figuratively) occasion of apostasy. KJV: offence, stumbling(-block, (-stone)).

προσκοπη.def: from προσκόπτω (G4350); a stumbling, i.e. (figuratively and concretely) occasion of sin. KJV: offence.

προσκοπτω.def: from πρός (G4314) and κόπτω (G2875); to strike at, i.e. surge against (as water); specially, to stub on, i.e. trip up (literally or figuratively). KJV: beat upon, dash, stumble (at).

προσκυλιω.def: from πρός (G4314) and κυλιόω (G2947); to roll towards, i.e. block against. KJV: roll (to).

προσκυνεω.def: from πρός (G4314) and a probable derivative of κύων (G2965) (meaning to kiss, like a dog licking his master's hand); to fawn or crouch to, i.e. (literally or figuratively) prostrate oneself in homage (do reverence to, adore). KJV: worship.

προσκυνητησ.def: from προσκυνέω (G4352); an adorer. KJV: worshipper.

προσλαλεω.def: from πρός (G4314) and λαλέω (G2980); to talk to, i.e. converse with. KJV: speak to (with).

προσλαμβανω.def: from πρός (G4314) and λαμβάνω (G2983); to take to oneself, i.e. use (food), lead (aside), admit (to friendship or hospitality). KJV: receive, take (unto).

προσμενω.def: from πρός (G4314) and μένω (G3306); to stay further, i.e. remain in a place, with a person; figuratively, to adhere to, persevere in. KJV: abide still, be with, cleave unto, continue in (with).

προσορμιζω.def: from πρός (G4314) and a derivative of the same as ὁρμή (G3730) (meaning to tie (anchor) or lull); to moor to, i.e. (by implication) land at. KJV: draw to the shore.

προσοφειλω.def: from πρός (G4314) and ὀφείλω (G3784); to be indebted additionally. KJV: over besides.

προσοχθιζω.def: from πρός (G4314) and a form of ὀχθέω (to be vexed with something irksome); to feel indignant at. KJV: be grieved at.

προσπεινοσ.def: from πρός (G4314) and the same as πεινάω (G3983); hungering further, i.e. intensely hungry. KJV: very hungry.

προσπηγνυμι.def: from πρός (G4314) and πήγνυμι (G4078); to fasten to, i.e. (specially), to impale (on a cross). KJV: crucify.

προσπιπτω.def: from πρός (G4314) and πίπτω (G4098); to fall towards, i.e. (gently) prostrate oneself (in supplication or homage), or (violently) to rush upon (in storm). KJV: beat upon, fall (down) at (before).

προσποιεομαι.def: middle voice from πρός (G4314) and ποιέω (G4160); to do forward for oneself, i.e. pretend (as if about to do a thing). KJV: make as though.

προσπορευομαι.def: from πρός (G4314) and πορεύομαι (G4198); to journey towards, i.e. approach (not the same as προπορεύομαι (G4313)). KJV: go before.

προσρηγνυμι.def: from πρός (G4314) and ῥήγνυμι (G4486); to tear towards, i.e. burst upon (as a tempest or flood). KJV: beat vehemently against (upon).

προστασσω.def: from πρός (G4314) and τάσσω (G5021); to arrange towards, i.e. (figuratively) enjoin. KJV: bid, command.

προστατισ.def: feminine of a derivative of προΐστημι (G4291); a patroness, i.e. assistant. KJV: succourer.

προστιθημι.def: from πρός (G4314) and τίθημι (G5087); to place additionally, i.e. lay beside, annex, repeat. KJV: add, again, give more, increase, lay unto, proceed further, speak to any more.

προστρεχω.def: from πρός (G4314) and τρέχω (G5143) (including its alternate); to run towards, i.e. hasten to meet or join. KJV: run (thither to, to).

προσφαγιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of πρός (G4314) and φάγω (G5315); something eaten in addition to bread, i.e. a relish (specially, fish; compare ὀψάριον (G3795)). KJV: meat.

προσφατοσ.def: from πρό (G4253) and a derivative of σφάζω (G4969); previously (recently) slain (fresh), i.e. (figuratively) lately made. KJV: new.

προσφατωσ.def: adverb from πρόσφατος (G4372); recently. KJV: lately.
