προσφερω.def: from πρός (G4314) and φέρω (G5342) (including its alternate); to bear towards, i.e. lead to, tender (especially to God), treat. KJV: bring (to, unto), deal with, do, offer (unto, up), present unto, put to.

προσφιλησ.def: from a presumed compound of πρός (G4314) and φιλέω (G5368); friendly towards, i.e. acceptable. KJV: lovely.

προσφορα.def: from προσφέρω (G4374); presentation; concretely, an oblation (bloodless) or sacrifice. KJV: offering (up).

προσφωνεω.def: from πρός (G4314) and φωνέω (G5455); to sound towards, i.e. address, exclaim, summon. KJV: call unto, speak (un-)to.

προσχυσισ.def: from a comparative of πρός (G4314) and χέω (to pour); a shedding forth, i.e. affusion. KJV: sprinkling.

προσψαυω.def: from πρός (G4314) and ψαύω (to touch); to impinge, i.e. lay a finger on (in order to relieve). KJV: touch.

προσωποληπτεω.def: from προσωπολήπτης (G4381); to favor an individual, i.e. show partiality. KJV: have respect to persons.

προσωποληπτησ.def: from πρόσωπον (G4383) and λαμβάνω (G2983); an accepter of a face (individual), i.e. (specially), one exhibiting partiality. KJV: respecter of persons.

προσωποληψια.def: from προσωπολήπτης (G4381); partiality, i.e. favoritism. KJV: respect of persons.

προσωπον.def: from πρός (G4314) and ὤψ (the visage, from ὀπτάνομαι (G3700)); the front (as being towards view), i.e. the countenance, aspect, appearance, surface; by implication, presence, person. KJV: (outward) appearance, X before, countenance, face, fashion, (men's) person, presence.

προτασσω.def: from πρό (G4253) and τάσσω (G5021); to pre-arrange, i.e. prescribe. KJV: before appoint.

προτεινω.def: from πρό (G4253) and τείνω (to stretch); to protend, i.e. tie prostrate (for scourging). KJV: bind.

προτερον.def: neuter of πρότερος (G4387) as adverb (with or without the article); previously. KJV: before, (at the) first, former.

προτεροσ.def: comparative of πρό (G4253); prior or previous. KJV: former.

προτιθεμαι.def: middle voice from πρό (G4253) and τίθημι (G5087); to place before, i.e. (for oneself) to exhibit; (to oneself) to propose (determine). KJV: purpose, set forth.

προτρεπομαι.def: middle voice from πρό (G4253) and the base of τροπή (G5157); to turn forward for oneself, i.e. encourage. KJV: exhort.

προτρεχω.def: from πρό (G4253) and τρέχω (G5143) (including its alternate); to run forward, i.e. outstrip, precede. KJV: outrun, run before.

προυπαρχω.def: from πρό (G4253) and ὑπάρχω (G5225); to exist before, i.e. (adverbially) to be or do something previously. KJV: + be before(-time).

προφασισ.def: from a compound of πρό (G4253) and φαίνω (G5316); an outward showing, i.e. pretext. KJV: cloke, colour, pretence, show.

προφερω.def: from πρό (G4253) and φέρω (G5342); to bear forward, i.e. produce. KJV: bring forth.

προφητεια.def: from προφήτης (G4396) ("prophecy"); prediction (scriptural or other). KJV: prophecy, prophesying.

προφητευω.def: from προφήτης (G4396); to foretell events, divine, speak under inspiration, exercise the prophetic office. KJV: prophesy.

προφητησ.def: from a compound of πρό (G4253) and φημί (G5346); a foreteller ("prophet"); by analogy, an inspired speaker; by extension, a poet. KJV: prophet.

προφητικοσ.def: from προφήτης (G4396); pertaining to a foreteller ("prophetic"). KJV: of prophecy, of the prophets.

προφητισ.def: feminine of προφήτης (G4396); a female foreteller or an inspired woman. KJV: prophetess.

προφθανω.def: from πρό (G4253) and φθάνω (G5348); to get an earlier start of, i.e. anticipate. KJV: prevent.

προχειριζομαι.def: middle voice from πρό (G4253) and a derivative of χείρ (G5495); to handle for oneself in advance, i.e. (figuratively) to purpose. KJV: choose, make.

προχειροτονεω.def: from πρό (G4253) and χειροτονέω (G5500); to elect in advance. KJV: choose before.

προχοροσ.def: from πρό (G4253) and χορός (G5525); before the dance; Prochorus, a Christian. KJV: Prochorus.

πρυμνα.def: feminine of πρυμνύς (hindmost); the stern of a ship. KJV: hinder part, stern.

πρωι.def: adverb from πρό (G4253); at dawn; by implication, the day-break watch. KJV: early (in the morning), (in the) morning.

πρωια.def: feminine of a derivative of πρωΐ (G4404) as noun; day-dawn. KJV: early, morning.

πρωιμοσ.def: from πρωΐ (G4404); dawning, i.e. (by analogy) autumnal (showering, the first of the rainy season). KJV: early.

πρωινοσ.def: from πρωΐ (G4404); pertaining to the dawn, i.e. matutinal. KJV: morning.

πρωρα.def: feminine of a presumed derivative of πρό (G4253) as noun; the prow, i.e. forward part of a vessel. KJV: forepart(-ship).

πρωτευω.def: from πρῶτος (G4413); to be first (in rank or influence). KJV: have the preeminence.

πρωτοκαθεδρια.def: from πρῶτος (G4413) and καθέδρα (G2515); a sitting first (in the front row), i.e. preeminence in council. KJV: chief (highest, uppermost) seat.

πρωτοκλισια.def: from πρῶτος (G4413) and κλισία (G2828); a reclining first (in the place of honor) at the dinner-bed, i.e. preeminence at meals. KJV: chief (highest, uppermost) room.

πρωτον.def: neuter of πρῶτος (G4413) as adverb (with or without ὁ (G3588)); firstly (in time, place, order, or importance). KJV: before, at the beginning, chiefly (at, at the) first (of all).

πρωτοσ.def: contracted superlative of πρό (G4253); foremost (in time, place, order or importance). KJV: before, beginning, best, chief(-est), first (of all), former.

πρωτοστατησ.def: from πρῶτος (G4413) and ἵστημι (G2476); one standing first in the ranks, i.e. a captain (champion). KJV: ringleader.

πρωτοτοκια.def: from πρωτότοκος (G4416); primogeniture (as a privilege). KJV: birthright.

πρωτοτοκοσ.def: from πρῶτος (G4413) and the alternate of τίκτω (G5088); first-born (usually as noun, literally or figuratively). KJV: firstbegotten(-born).

πταιω.def: a form of πίπτω (G4098); to trip, i.e. (figuratively) to err, sin, fail (of salvation). KJV: fall, offend, stumble.

πτερνα.def: of uncertain derivation; the heel (figuratively). KJV: heel.

πτερυγιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of πτέρυξ (G4420); a winglet, i.e. (figuratively) extremity (top corner). KJV: pinnacle.

πτερυξ.def: from a derivative of πέτομαι (G4072) (meaning a feather); a wing. KJV: wing.

πτηνον.def: contraction for πετεινόν (G4071); a bird. KJV: bird.

πτοεω.def: probably akin to the alternate of πίπτω (G4098) (through the idea of causing to fall) or to πέτομαι (G4072) (through that of causing to fly away); to scare. KJV: frighten.

πτολεμαισ.def: from Πτολεμαῖος (Ptolemy, after whom it was named); Ptolemais, a place in Palestine. KJV: Ptolemais.

πτυον.def: from πτύω (G4429); a winnowing-fork (as scattering like spittle). KJV: fan.

πτυρω.def: from a presumed derivative of πτύω (G4429) (and thus akin to πτοέω (G4422)); to frighten. KJV: terrify.

πτυσσω.def: probably akin to πετάννυμι (to spread; and thus apparently allied to πέτομαι (G4072) through the idea of expansion, and to 4429 through that of flattening; compare πατέω (G3961)); to fold, i.e. furl a scroll. KJV: close.

πτυω.def: a primary verb (compare πτύσσω (G4428)); to spit. KJV: spit.

πτωμα.def: from the alternate of πίπτω (G4098); a ruin, i.e. (specially), lifeless body (corpse, carrion). KJV: dead body, carcase, corpse.

πτωσισ.def: from the alternate of πίπτω (G4098); a crash, i.e. downfall (literally or figuratively). KJV: fall.

πτωχεια.def: from πτωχεύω (G4433); beggary, i.e. indigence (literally or figuratively). KJV: poverty.

πτωχευω.def: from πτωχός (G4434); to be a beggar, i.e. (by implication) to become indigent (figuratively). KJV: become poor.

πτωχοσ.def: from πτώσσω (to crouch); akin to πτοέω (G4422) and the alternate of πίπτω (G4098)); a beggar (as cringing), i.e. pauper (strictly denoting absolute or public mendicancy, although also used in a qualified or relative sense; whereas πένης (G3993) properly means only straitened circumstances in private), literally (often as noun) or figuratively (distressed). KJV: beggar(-ly), poor.

πυγμη.def: from a primary πύξ (the fist as a weapon); the clenched hand, i.e. (only in dative case as adverb) with the fist (hard scrubbing). KJV: oft.

πυθων.def: from Πυθώ (the name of the region where Delphi, the seat of the famous oracle, was located); a Python, i.e. (by analogy, with the supposed diviner there) inspiration (soothsaying). KJV: divination.

πυκνοσ.def: from the same as σκηνοποιός (G4635); clasped (thick), i.e. (figuratively) frequent; neuter plural (as adverb) frequently. KJV: often(-er).

πυκτεω.def: from a derivative of the same as πυγμή (G4435); to box (with the fist), i.e. contend (as a boxer) at the games (figuratively). KJV: fight.

πυλη.def: apparently a primary word; a gate, i.e. the leaf or wing of a folding entrance (literally or figuratively). KJV: gate.

πυλων.def: from πύλη (G4439); a gate-way, door-way of a building or city; by implication, a portal or vestibule. KJV: gate, porch.

πυνθανομαι.def: middle voice prolonged from a primary πύθω (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to question, i.e. ascertain by inquiry (as a matter of information merely; and thus differing from ἐρωτάω (G2065), which properly means a request as a favor; and from αἰτέω (G154), which is strictly a demand for something due; as well as from ζητέω (G2212), which implies a search for something hidden; and from δέομαι (G1189), which involves the idea of urgent need); by implication, to learn (by casual intelligence). KJV: ask, demand, enquire, understand.

πυρ.def: a primary word; "fire" (literally or figuratively, specially, lightning). KJV: fiery, fire.

πυρα.def: from πῦρ (G4442); a fire (concretely). KJV: fire.

πυργοσ.def: apparently a primary word ("burgh"); a tower or castle. KJV: tower.

πυρεσσω.def: from πυρά (G4443); to be on fire, i.e. (specially), to have a fever. KJV: be sick of a fever.

πυρετοσ.def: from πυρέσσω (G4445); inflamed, i.e. (by implication) feverish (as noun, fever). KJV: fever.

πυρινοσ.def: from πυρά (G4443); fiery, i.e. (by implication) flaming. KJV: of fire.

πυροω.def: from πῦρ (G4442); to kindle, i.e. (passively) to be ignited, glow (literally), be refined (by implication), or (figuratively) to be inflamed (with anger, grief, lust). KJV: burn, fiery, be on fire, try.

πυρραζω.def: from πυῤῥός (G4450); to redden (intransitively). KJV: be red.

πυρροσ.def: from πῦρ (G4442); fire-like, i.e. (specially), flame- colored. KJV: red.

πυρωσισ.def: from πυρόω (G4448); ignition, i.e. (specially), smelting (figuratively, conflagration, calamity as a test). KJV: burning, trial.

πω.def: another form of the base of -πώς (G4458); an enclitic particle of indefiniteness; yet, even; used only in the comparative. See μηδέπω (G3369), μήπω (G3380), οὐδέπω (G3764), οὔπω (G3768), πώποτε (G4455).

πωλεω.def: probably ultimately from πέλομαι (to be busy, to trade); to barter (as a pedlar), i.e. to sell. KJV: sell, whatever is sold.

πωλοσ.def: apparently a primary word; a "foal" or "filly", i.e. (specially), a young ass. KJV: colt.

πωποτε.def: from -πω (G4452) and ποτέ (G4218); at any time, i.e. (with negative particle) at no time. KJV: at any time, + never (…to any man), + yet, never man.

πωροω.def: apparently from πῶρος (a kind of stone); to petrify, i.e. (figuratively) to indurate (render stupid or callous). KJV: blind, harden.

πωρωσισ.def: from πωρόω (G4456); stupidity or callousness. KJV: blindness, hardness.

πωσ.def: adverb from the base of πού (G4225); an enclitic particle of indefiniteness of manner; somehow or anyhow; used only in composition. KJV: haply, by any (some) means, perhaps.

adverb from the base of ποῦ (G4226); an interrogative particle of manner; in what way? (sometimes the question is indirect, how?); also as exclamation, how much!. KJV: how, after (by) what manner (means), that.
